page0.text:
The terrace falls.
The man's Noble Phantasm goes through the wall of the castle and destroys the hall's walls.

page1.text:
...
I don't move a step in the midst of it all.
I don't care about the rubble that falls from above.
I don't have the composure to run, and I have no intention to run.
It doesn't matter whether a big piece of rubble grazes my back.
I can't think of taking my eyes off of that man right now.

page2.text:
"...Oh. So it's Saber's Master."
...
His red eyes react to my enmity.

page3.text:
My blood boils.
I'll die in the next instant. There's no way I'm not afraid of that.
But my body refuses to run away and keeps screaming to defeat that enemy right now.
The corpse of the girl that was killed mercilessly keeps ordering me not to forgive him.

page4.text:
It's only natural for me to lose all reasoning.
My mind churns from the contradicting desires of life and death.

page5.text:
...
"You seem to have the will to fight but it's no use talking about it. You are worthless without Saber."
A sword appears in the man's left hand.
The sword is raised mercilessly and should come down to kill me.

page6.text:
...
Even then, I keep staring at the enemy.
I can't think of showing my back to that man.

page7.text:
"...Hold on. I know this guy."
The man's sword stops.
Shinji, who was watching from the other side of the wall, starts walking to the center of the hall with light steps.

page8.text:
"Hey, it's been a while, Emiya. I didn't expect to see you here, so I'm a bit surprised."
...

page9.text:
The man doesn't move.
There's about ten meters between us.
...Would I be able to get near him? Even Berserker could not close this distance.

page10.text:
"Oh, are you so scared you can't even talk!? Well, I understand how you feel. I was the same with Rider.
Yeah, that's right, that's right! Man, I'm glad you let me go that time, Emiya!"

page11.text:
There's nothing I can use as a weapon.
But I don't care.
My mind is clear right now.
I don't feel any uneasiness about Projecting his swords in this situation...

page12.text:
"Hey. I'm telling you to look over here...!"
...

page13.text:
...I slightly shift my gaze in his direction.
I face Shinji, while keeping the man in my vision.

page14.text:
"That's right. So you do know who's the most important one here?"
...
I gasp a little.
It's not Shinji's words, but rather the unexpectedly serious manner in which he says them.

page15.text: "So that's how it is. You do know right, Emiya? You'll certainly die like this."

page16.text:
...How out-of-place.
Why say something that's so obvious now?

page17.text:
"I didn't get to introduce him yet, but that's my new Servant. He's more amazing than Rider, right?"
Shinji puts his hand over the man's shoulder.
And with a delighted face...
"Beg for your life, Emiya. I might consider it."
He says some nonsense.

page18.text:
"I refuse."
I have no doubt.
I answer right away, without showing any hesitation or showing any signs of even considering it.

page19.text:
"Guh...! Fine, then you can die...!"
Shinji jumps back.

page20.text:
The man, still with a cold expression, finally brings his raised sword dow—
"That's it. I won't guarantee your Master's life if you even move your finger an inch, you Servant."
And the man stops his sword again.

page21.text:
Everyone looks up.
Everyone in the hall turns their attention to the girl standing at the terrace.

page22.text:
Tohsaka's hand is faced towards Shinji.
Even though Shinji doesn't have the aptitude as a mage, he should know what that means.
Tohsaka is serious.
If that man brings down his sword, she will kill Shinji as retaliation.

page23.text:
"T-Tohsaka...! Why are you here...!?"
...
Tohsaka doesn't answer, but just keeps her aim aligned on Shinji.

page24.text:
"W-What, are you really going to shoot me, you murderer..!?"
"You're the one who killed first.
Well, whichever it is, that doesn't matter. Shinji. The right to kill and to be killed are the same. You should instinctively understand that as a human, even if you're not a mage."
"Guh..."
Shinji weakly retreats, being glared down by Tohsaka.

page25.text:
At that...
"...Hm."
That guy is watching in delight.

page26.text:
He looks at Tohsaka, as if to belittle her.
"...?"
...Then...
I feel like there was a strange vibration that took over the hall for an instant.

page27.text: "I see. You know you will not be able to defeat me, so you went after my Master instead. You brought on the negotiation because you know that I would not stop even if you killed my Master."

page28.text:
"...That's right. You wouldn't stop even if Shinji dies. But you can consider it in this situation, right?
You can save Shinji right now. You're a Servant, so it should be a hard blow to lose your Master."

page29.text:
"Heh. I see, I see, you are pretty quick-witted. That is the only negotiation if you want to save that mongrel."
The sword disappears.
He turns his back to me as if he lost interest in me.

page30.text:
"Guh...! What are you doing!? Who told you to stop...!?"
"No... The situation changed, Shinji. She will be perfect as a vessel."
"Huh...?"

page31.text:
Shinji's breath stops.
His face filled with irritation suddenly turns into a dirty smile.
"I see... Man, I'm glad that you're alive, Tohsaka."

page32.text: "Really. I'm relieved as well. I've known you for a long time, even if you're like that. I would be disheartened if you died somewhere."

page33.text:
Laughing happily, Shinji claps his hands.
...It's strange.
Shinji shows no fear even though Tohsaka can end his life.
It seems like an overwhelming joy is numbing his emotions.

page34.text:
"Oh well. That aside, how about this, Tohsaka? Why don't you forget about Emiya and team up with us?"
"...Us?"

page35.text: "That's right. You also know how Caster is stocking up power, right? The Ryudou Temple is the altar this time. It's a bit unfavorable for us if she's taking position there and stocking up magical energy."

page36.text:
Shinji says with both arms raised.
But, that's an obvious fact.
On top of that, it seems like Shinji doesn't know about how Caster obtained Saber and Archer.

page37.text:
"See, you can tell right? The chance of victory is slim by myself.
I beat Berserker's Master, but this isn't enough. We can make something that can even beat Caster if you join us."
Shinji invites her with confidence.
To that...

page38.text:
"I refuse, Shinji. I don't know who you're connected with. But I have no reason to follow a guy that is obviously being used."
Tohsaka refuses him without twitching a brow.

page39.text:
"W-What...?"
"Can't you tell? I'm warning you since I've known you for a long time, but you should get the intelligence to observe what's going on around you.
You're the only person that thinks Shinji Matou is a Master. Don't you realize by now that you don't have talent as a mage?"
"You...!"

page40.text:
Shinji's face twitches.
Tohsaka's harsh words must've made him forget that his life is in her hands.
"Do it, Gilgamesh! Kill Emiya and Tohsaka...!"
Shinji orders to his own Servant.

page41.text:
...
"W-What, I told you to kill them...! It should be easy for you to kill them before I get killed...!"
"...No, unfortunately, we are out of time. It will rot if we let it be any longer."

page42.text:
The man shows Shinji, who is closing in on him, the thing in his right hand.
...A red lump.
It's the thing that he took out of the girl, it's still throbbing.

page43.text:
"Khh..."
Shinji grits his teeth in vexation.

page44.text:
"...Damn, don't regret it, Tohsaka! I won't let you be on my side now...!"
Shinji runs towards the front entrance.

page45.text:
...There's one person left.
After the man slowly watches his Master being angry...
"So that is it. You have a good friend."
He says delightfully and leaves the hall filled with rubble.
